merge sample psi tables without any functions just to get logic working

read in file paths

```{r read_files}
## Directories ##
# find project root to access separate results dir
repo_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_git_root)

# result directories
results_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "results")
compendium_results_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "merged_shiba")
version_dir <- file.path(compendium_results_dir, "v1.1.0_two_sample")
psi_dir <- file.path(version_dir, "sample_psi")

# sample sheet dir
config_dir <- file.path(repo_root, "config")

# merged psi table output dir
output_dir <- file.path(version_dir, "merged_psi")

# create output dir if it does not exist
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
  dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}


## Files ##

# sample sheet file with sample names
samples_file <- file.path(config_dir, "two_sample_merge_samples.tsv")

# read in sample sheet and create list of samples from samples column
samples <- readr::read_tsv(samples_file, col_types = list(.default = "c")) |>
  dplyr::pull(sample) |>
  as.list()

# define list of PSI results files corresponding to event types quantified by Shiba bulk analysis
psi_file_list <- c(
  se = "PSI_SE.txt",
  afe = "PSI_AFE.txt",
  ale = "PSI_ALE.txt",
  five = "PSI_FIVE.txt",
  three = "PSI_THREE.txt",
  mse = "PSI_MSE.txt",
  mxe = "PSI_MXE.txt",
  ri = "PSI_RI.txt"
)

# make sample psi table paths
sample_paths <- file.path(
  psi_dir,
  samples
)

# output files
out_file_list <- c(
  se = "PSI_SE.txt",
  afe = "PSI_AFE.txt",
  ale = "PSI_ALE.txt",
  five = "PSI_FIVE.txt",
  three = "PSI_THREE.txt",
  mse = "PSI_MSE.txt",
  mxe = "PSI_MXE.txt",
  ri = "PSI_RI.txt",
  matrix = "PSI_matrix_sample.txt",
  all_events = "all_events_PSI.txt"
)

# construct output file paths
out_paths <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  out_file_list
)

# pass out_file_list names to output paths so purrr can match them up
names(out_paths) <- names(out_file_list)
```

read in psi files

```{r}
# read tables into dataframes
sample_one_se_df <- file.path(sample_paths[1], psi_file_list[1]) |>
  readr::read_tsv(col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c"))


sample_two_se_df <- file.path(sample_paths[2], psi_file_list[1]) |>
  readr::read_tsv(col_types = readr::cols(.default = "c"))

# merge two samples' event tables together horizontally
merged_se_df <- dplyr::left_join(
  sample_one_se_df,
  sample_two_se_df,
  by = c(
    "event_id",
    "pos_id", 
    "gene_id",
    "exon",
    "intron_a",
    "intron_b",
    "intron_c",
    "strand",
    "gene_name",
    "label")
) |>
  dplyr::relocate(
    "event_id",
    "pos_id",
    "gene_id"
  )

```
